question: Does adding player information find more future 80+ players than ranking by FIFA potential at the same review budget?
eligible: Current overall <70, any age, no previously observed 85+ rating. Potential must be recorded for the paired comparison.
target: Observed 80+ in one of the next three editions.
training: Sub-80 origins; no prior 85+; three-edition outcome window ends by decision date.
followup: An observed target confirms a positive; negative requires all three future records; otherwise unresolved.
weighting: Sub-70 emphasis, inverse repeated-player training count, positive weighting and bounded extra weight for large positive gains; exact function dated_weights in source.
bootstrap: 500 draws; player IDs jointly resampled across editions; full annual rankings reselected at 50; fitted models fixed.
scope: Retrospective replays on a previously explored archive. Conditional intervals do not include model-selection uncertainty or variation across future seasons.
